title: OutboxSyncWriteFacade._enqueue swallows every drain-tee failure with no log and no AppLogger field in the class
why: OutboxSyncWriteFacade never declares an AppLogger field, so this catchError has no way to log even if it wanted to. Any exception from the drain tee -- including the UnmountedRefException from the companion SM-4 finding, or a genuine permission-denied/network failure -- is discarded with zero trace. Every push*/enqueue* method in this class, used for every sync write in the app, funnels through this one _enqueue, making it the single choke point where all fire-and-forget drain failures currently vanish silently. No test in this batch (including the 1184-line local_data_upload_service_test.dart, which never wires onEnqueueDrain) exercises this path either.
recommendation: Inject an AppLogger into OutboxSyncWriteFacade (mirroring LocalDataUploadService's existing nullable _logger field) and log the swallowed exception at warn/error level inside catchError before discarding it.
acceptance_criteria: EH-3 Rule-0 checker (log-less catch grep) reports no hits in outbox_sync_write_facade.dart.
Unit test that stubs onEnqueueDrain to throw and asserts the logger receives the error.
